description: Aggregate a 180-row sales CSV into exact JSON figures.

contract.objective: Analyse sales.csv in the task workspace and write summary.json with exactly these keys: "row_count" (number of data rows), "total_revenue" (sum of units × unit_price over all rows, rounded to 2 decimals), "revenue_by_region" (object mapping each region to its revenue, rounded to 2 decimals) and "top_product_by_units" (the product with the most units sold). Numbers must be JSON numbers, not strings.
acceptance_criteria: summary.json is valid JSON with the four requested keys
Every figure is computed from all rows of sales.csv
